strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
(I've seen it so many times...@but I still don't know who that girl is.)
(Can someone I don't remember ever meeting@really show up in my dreams...?)
(As long as he sends money, the kid'll raise@himself... That's what Dad thinks, I bet.)
(Is it that late already? I need to get to school.)
...You look sleepy, Touya.@Up late playing <Burning PT> again?
Not exactly. I just woke up on the wrong side.
Oh... Is it because of that dream again?
It's like getting woken up by a gorgeous girl.@Lucky you. Me, I get my twin sister,@and I'm sick of seeing her every day.
If you don't like it, get up on your own.
Can't be helped. We've been busy lately.
You're not the only one who's busy.
More importantly, Touya...@shouldn't you talk to a counselor?@Didn't a teacher recommend it the other day?
Hey, Touya. What's this about a counselor?
Oh, they told me to go see one regularly.@I don't have any parents at home,@so I live by myself, right?
The teachers seem nervous@about how to handle families like mine.
As part of the postwar recovery effort?
No, apparently a student in a situation@like mine went missing a while back...
So someone higher up probably told@the school to take proper care of kids like me.
It's not like you live alone@because you want to...
Hey, Touya.@If you want, I'll come cook for you again.
That'd help, but weren't you busy?
Okay, stop. That's confidential company info.
Whoops, my bad. That slipped out.
Anyway, today we've got to head straight@home the second school's over.
(...By company, she has to mean@Mogami Heavy Industries.)
(It's a pretty big corporation, but the@president's kids have to help out...?@Are they really that short-handed?)
Ah, perfect timing.@Our guests from Tokyo just arrived.@Let me introduce you. This is...
I'm his little sister, Shoko. Nice to meet you.
W-Wait, are you the pilot@of the Compatible Kaiser...?@And Fighter Roar...?
Wait, you know about Fighter Roar?
Y-Yeah... He's pretty famous online.@The life-size hero in red armor who showed@up in Asakusa, Tokyo, and fought the <Shura>...
A-And to think he's@a kid about our age...
I get it with the Compati Kaiser, it stands out,@but I didn't know Fighter Roar@was famous too.
What are you talking about? Tons of tourists'@videos from Asakusa got posted online.
Huh.@Well, I was flyin' around pretty flashy.
Nope. I don't go online much.
Huh?! In this day and age?@How do you do your shopping?
I go to the shops in the neighborhood, duh.
No, I mean like online shopping.
I ain't botherin' with that kinda hassle.
Oh, it's fine, that's just my brother.@He hardly ever uses his <D-Con>.
(If my big-spender brother got into online@shopping, we'd be in serious trouble~)
Akimi, Akemi.@You two haven't introduced yourselves yet.
Oh, right.@I'm Akimi Akatsuki. And this is...
Akimi and Akemi? Man, that's confusing.
Anyway, Kota, Shoko...@thanks for coming all this way.
Partly 'cause Gramps and Jinpu@are old buddies, but...
Roa told me the Kaiser crashed@down around here.@I always wanted to come see it once.
See, the Compati Kaiser's a robot built in@another world. It fought a baddie called@<Dark Brain> and got flung into our world.
And where it landed was this test site, I hear.
Me, the president, and Kisaburo were all there.
The Compati Kaiser's original owner, a guy@who fought <Dark Brain>'s gang.@He's the one who gave me the Roa Armor.
Right now, he ain't got a body.@He's inside the crystal on the armor.
Hold on, what do you mean no body...
I said Roa fought Dark Brain and got flung@over here, right? Back then, Roa and the@Kaiser were both in real bad shape.
Yes... For Roa to go on existing, he had@to cast off his damaged body and place@his soul inside the crystal.
Gramps took his time fixing@up the Kaiser, though.
Then during the <Shura Revolt>, the <Shura>@showed up in Asakusa. Roa trusted me with@the armor, and I became Fighter Roar.
All right, that's enough talk.@Let's get started. Akimi, Kota, get ready.
...Didn't notice on the way in, but that's all@part of the grounds too? This place is huge.
That is precisely why we were able to hide@the fact that the Compatible Kaiser and I@transferred here.
We got lucky, huh? When you crashed down,@Gramps and the Mogami president were here.
Yes... Having lost my mothership in the@battle with <Dark Brain>, I had nowhere@to turn.
It was much larger than that.
Akimi and the others are about to come out.
Hey, Shoko.@When we're done, let's go get sea urchin bowls,@salmon roe bowls, and miso ramen.
We can't afford to splurge like that. Pick one.
Aw, c'mon! We came all the way to Hokkaido!
We had you come all the way out here.@I'll treat you to as many salmon roe@bowls as you want later.
Ooh, now that's what I like to hear.
Mighty Walker Operation System,@all green. Output, no problems.
Heh, so that's the Soul Food, huh?
Yep, yep, there's lamb barbecue and soup curry...
Heh, I was just playin' off Jinpu's joke,@but you sure roll with it.
The Soul Saber... It's got a human-looking@face, just like the Compatible Kaiser...
It's meant to have a psychological effect@on whoever faces it. Kisaburo's idea.@Same deal as those Nio guardian statues.
Weird comparison, but I like it.
All right... First up, a mock battle in the@FF equipment. Do it right, Akimi.
FF stands for Fighter First...@It's the high-mobility close-combat setup.@And the main pilot in that form is me.
There's also the GG equipment...@That's the heavy-armor long-range setup.@The main pilot in that form is me.
So it transforms, like Hugo and Aqua's@Garmraid Blaze?
No, we have to swap it out in a hangar.
We could build in a transforming mechanism.@But that'd make the structure complicated,@harder to maintain, and pricier to build.
To rival <Tesla Reich Institute>, <Mao Industries>@and <Isurugi Heavy Industries> robots, we gotta@compete on cost, upkeep, and solid build.
Jinpu, are you planning to sell the@Soul Saber to the <Earth Federation Army>?
We didn't develop it purely for profit...@But we're a company. Running a charity@ain't gonna cut it.
Kisaburo's amazing that way.@He does all that stuff without caring@about profit at all.
Well, Gramps has a fortune.@Not that I've ever seen that money, and it@barely shows in how we live day to day.
Well, obviously.@Gramps's development and upkeep costs aside...
If I didn't manage everything else, he'd@spend every last cent we have.
More like stingy.@So, Jinpu, how're you gonna sell it to the Feds?
Well, <Personal Trooper> and@<Armored Module> types@get mass-produced, but...
Right now, nearly every super robot@is pretty much a limited edition.
True. Lots of 'em are one-offs,@just like the Compati Kaiser.
Well, building lots of mass-produced units@and winning with numbers is probably best...
But plenty of those alien mechs and monsters@are real hulking brutes. If nothin' but those@showed up, they'd be a nightmare to handle.
So the president and I figured there'd be@demand for a mass-produced super robot...
And we launched a project for a unit that's@strong, cheap, and easy to handle, all three.
Mind you, with the Soul Saber prototype,@since it's partly a demonstration, we built@some parts without worrying about budget.
We work as test pilots to show@how easy it is to handle.
I'm not planning to stop at just that.
Not this again...@Eventually, a Federation Army pilot@is going to be flying it.
C'mon, have some attachment.@We got it far enough for mock battles,@so we could handle real combat too.
I don't want to be helpless like during the@<Shura Revolt>. Kota and Shoko are fighting,@and if I had the Soul Saber, I could...
Don't get cocky, greenhorn.@Those two have been through hell you@can't even imagine.
Besides, the president won't stand for it.@Did you forget the uproar when you two said@you wanted to be test pilots?
But I don't want the Soul Saber we built@used for anything besides defending Earth...
The president and I feel the same.@But folks who build weapons@ain't in a position to preach.
All right, let's start the mock battle.@The president's been pestering me@to see the data right away.
Akimi, like I said, he's a veteran.@Go in like you're there to learn.
I'll show you a thing or two. Come on!
Akimi, his output is higher than ours!@So...
I know! We'll win with speed!
Kota, they're not used to combat.@Don't go overboard.
Even so, goin' easy on 'em@won't do 'em any good!
Heh, you're better than I figured.
For something called practical and sturdy,@its mobility is quite impressive.
Did you see that, Jinpu?!@Even against the Compatible Kaiser, look at this!
Don't get carried away.@He's in normal form, not combined@with the G-Thundergate.
But we're developing a flight unit@for the Soul Saber too, aren't we?
Huh, you're building something like that?
Yeah, with extra weapons too. It's not done yet.
(Before we fit it with the Saber Booster,@we gotta sort out the output problem...)
...So, I guess it's my turn next.
Right, let's switch to the GG equipment. Come@back in for now. Kota, you take a break.
Then I'll head back for now too.
How about that, Akemi?@I beat the Compatible Kaiser with the FF gear.
Your turn next, Akemi.@Don't embarrass yourself with the GG gear.
Oh, just be quiet already!@I've got over 30 check items I wanted@to confirm during the mock battle!
He's at the offshore plant right now, right?@Wonder what's up.
...Akimi, the FF equipment seems to be@shaping up nicely.
Yeah, though the GG mock battle's still to come.
Once that's done and the final adjustments@are finished, we deliver it@to the Federation Army.
I can't wait for that day.
Geez, you really have no attachment to it.@We're saying goodbye to our Soul Saber.
That's the spare. We've barely flown it.
We'll be flying it after Unit 1's delivered.@To develop the Saber Booster.
By the way, about you two and Kota.......Hm?
Th-The sky...! Can't you see it from there?!
The president said something about the sky.@Let's head outside and take a look ourselves.
